changelog: To send, you now type the first letters of who the message is going to, so pressing Enter, or typing "send" again out of habit, can no longer send it.
features: The Send box asks you to type the first letters of who the message is going to. Enter alone cannot send, and neither can an everyday reply such as "send", "no" or "ok"
What was wrong in 0.9.23: the box had Accept already selected, so an extra Enter right after typing "send" could accept it before you had seen it
The letters asked for are always longer than any everyday reply word the name begins with: for @noah you type "noa"; a name that is itself such a word needs "@" and the whole name
A message kept for someone not on /vibe yet is confirmed the same way
The agent is told never to tell you what to type in the box

Everything else is as in 0.9.23: where /vibe can tell that you typed, you say send first and then confirm in the box; after a decline no box opens again until you type; with nobody at the keyboard nothing goes
